_comment: ADR-010 §5 step 4 panel. Import into a Grafana Cloud dashboard once the account/data source exist (metrics-agent/README.md step 5). This is a single Grafana panel definition, not a full dashboard export -- paste into a dashboard's `panels` array, or use Grafana's 'Import panel' JSON paste in the panel editor.
title: Dispatch offer -> accept latency (P95, Fly)
description: Cross-replica P95 of spinr_dispatch_offer_to_accept_duration_ms, provider=fly only. SLA target: < 2000ms (CLAUDE.md Performance SLAs table). Uses histogram_quantile over summed buckets across replicas -- NOT an average of per-replica P95s (ADR-010 §2 explicitly flags averaging per-replica quantiles as a well-known Prometheus mistake).
